# In-app assistant: tool reference

<!-- Generated by AgentToolDocsTest from the live tool registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The assistant controls Nuvio through **74 tools**. Each tool has a name, a description the model reads, a JSON-schema for its parameters and returns a JSON object (`{"ok": true, …}` or `{"ok": false, "error": …, "code": …}`).
Tools marked **⚠ confirm** show a confirmation dialog and only run if the user approves. Tools marked **parallel** are read-only and may run concurrently when the model issues several calls at once.

## Capability inventory

Nuvio has no ViewModels: every screen reads state from singleton repositories (`object …Repository` in `composeApp/src/commonMain`) and navigates through `NuvioNavigator`. The assistant reaches the same entry points:

| Area | App entry points | Agent tools |
|---|---|---|
| Screen state | `AgentBridge.navigation` (route, back stack, tab), screen repositories' `uiState` | `get_app_state`, `get_visible_items` |
| Navigation | `NuvioNavigator`, `AppScreenTab`, `CatalogLaunchStore` | `open_tab`, `go_back`, `open_title`, `open_person`, `open_catalog`, `open_settings`, `open_downloads` |
| Search & discover | `SearchRepository`, `SearchHistoryRepository`, `HomeRepository`, `CatalogRepository` | `search_titles`, `discover`, `list_home_rows`, `get_catalog_page`, `get_search_history`, `remove_search_history_entry` |
| Title details | `MetaDetailsRepository` | `get_title_details`, `list_episodes` |
| Streams | `StreamsRepository`, stream picker (`AgentStreamScreenHandle`) | `play_title`, `list_streams`, `filter_streams_by_addon`, `play_stream`, `download_stream` |
| Player | player runtime (`AgentPlayerHandle`: play/pause/seek/speed/tracks/subtitles/next episode/close) | `get_player_state`, `player_pause`, `player_resume`, `player_seek`, `player_set_speed`, `player_select_audio`, `player_select_subtitles`, `player_set_subtitle_delay`, `player_next_episode`, `player_close` |
| Library | `LibraryRepository` | `get_library`, `is_in_library`, `add_to_library`, `remove_from_library`, `clear_library` |
| Progress & watched | `WatchProgressRepository`, `WatchedRepository` | `get_continue_watching`, `get_watch_progress`, `remove_from_continue_watching`, `set_watched`, `is_watched` |
| Addons | `AddonRepository` | `list_addons`, `install_addon`, `remove_addon`, `set_addon_enabled`, `move_addon`, `refresh_addons` |
| Settings | `PlayerSettingsRepository`, `ThemeSettingsRepository`, `MetaScreenSettingsRepository`, `ContinueWatchingPreferencesRepository`, `HomeCatalogSettingsRepository`, `SearchHistoryRepository` | `list_settings`, `set_setting`, `list_home_rows_settings`, `configure_home_row`, `reset_home_rows`, `reset_details_layout` |
| Account & profiles | `AuthRepository`, `ProfileRepository` | `get_account`, `switch_profile`, `sign_out` |
| Downloads | `DownloadsRepository` | `list_downloads`, `download_stream`, `manage_download` |
| Collections | `CollectionRepository` | `list_collections`, `delete_collection`, `move_collection` |
| Web | built-in | `web_search`, `fetch_url` |
| Stremio addon protocol | built-in (manifest, /catalog, /meta, /stream, /subtitles) | `addon_manifest`, `addon_catalog`, `addon_meta`, `addon_streams`, `addon_subtitles` |
| Utilities & memory | built-in | `calculate`, `get_current_time`, `remember`, `recall`, `forget` |

Navigation destinations (`AppRoute`): Home/Search/Library/Settings tabs → `open_tab`; title details (`DetailRoute`) → `open_title`; person (`PersonDetailRoute`) → `open_person`; catalog page (`CatalogRoute`) → `open_catalog`; stream picker (`StreamRoute`) → `play_title`; player (`PlayerRoute`) → `play_stream`; downloads (`DownloadsRoute`) → `open_downloads`; every settings page (addons, plugins, account, playback, streams, appearance, home screen, title page, continue watching, collections, integrations, notifications, debrid, licenses…) → `open_settings`; back → `go_back`.

## App state (read-only)

### `get_app_state` — parallel

Read the current app state: which screen is open (and its title/id), the selected tab, the navigation back stack, account/profile, addon and library counts, and a short summary of what is playing. Call this first when you need to know where the user is.

Calls: `AgentNavigationHandle.currentRoute`, `AgentNavigationHandle.routes`, `AgentNavigationHandle.selectedTab`

### `get_visible_items` — parallel

List the items currently shown on screen (home rows, search results, catalog page, title details, stream list or library), with ids you can pass to other tools.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer |  | Max items per list (default 15) |

Calls: `HomeRepository.uiState`, `SearchRepository.uiState`, `CatalogRepository.uiState`, `MetaDetailsRepository.uiState`, `StreamsRepository.uiState`

## Navigation

### `open_tab`

Switch to a main tab: home, search, library or settings (the Profile tab). Pops any screens on top.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tab` | `home` \| `search` \| `library` \| `settings` | yes | Tab to open |

Calls: `AgentNavigationHandle.selectTab`

### `go_back`

Navigate back one screen (like the system back button).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `times` | integer |  | How many screens to go back (default 1) |

Calls: `AgentNavigationHandle.back`

### `open_title`

Open the details screen of a movie or series by id (IMDb ids like tt0133093 or addon ids). Use search_titles first if you only know the name.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Title id, e.g. tt0133093 |
| `type` | `movie` \| `series` \| `anime` \| `channel` \| `tv` | yes | movie or series |

Calls: `AgentNavigationHandle.openDetails`, `MetaDetailsRepository.load`

### `open_person`

Open a cast/crew member's page (needs the tmdb_person_id from get_title_details).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tmdb_person_id` | integer | yes | TMDB person id |
| `name` | string | yes | Person name |

Calls: `AgentNavigationHandle.navigate`

### `open_settings`

Open a settings screen (addons, playback, appearance, account, downloads, …).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | `root` \| `account` \| `addons` \| `plugins` \| `playback` \| `streams` \| `appearance` \| `postercustomization` \| `homescreen` \| `metascreen` \| `continuewatching` \| `contentdiscovery` \| `integrations` \| `notifications` \| `debrid` \| `advanced` \| `licensesattributions` \| `downloads` \| `collections` | yes | Settings page |

Calls: `AgentNavigationHandle.openSettingsPage`

### `open_downloads`

Open the Downloads screen (offline files).

### `open_catalog`

Open a full catalog page from an installed addon (e.g. Cinemeta "Popular" movies), optionally filtered by genre. Get addon and catalog ids from list_addons or list_home_rows.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addon` | string | yes | Installed addon name, id or manifest URL |
| `type` | string | yes | Content type of the catalog, e.g. movie or series |
| `catalog_id` | string | yes | Catalog id from the addon manifest, e.g. top |
| `genre` | string |  | Optional genre filter |

Calls: `AgentNavigationHandle.openCatalog`, `CatalogRepository.load`

## Search, catalogs and discovery

### `search_titles`

Search movies and series across the installed addons' search catalogs (same as the Search tab). Returns ids/types to use with open_title, get_title_details or play_title. By default the query is also shown on the Search tab so the user sees the results.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Title or keywords, e.g. "The Matrix" |
| `type` | `movie` \| `series` \| `any` |  | Only return this type |
| `show_in_app` | boolean |  | Show the query on the Search tab (default true) |
| `limit` | integer |  | Max results (default 10) |

Calls: `SearchRepository.search`, `SearchRepository.clear`, `SearchHistoryRepository.recordSearch`

### `list_home_rows` — parallel

List the catalog rows on the Home screen (key, title, addon) with their first items.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items_per_row` | integer |  | Items to include per row (default 5) |

Calls: `HomeRepository.uiState`

### `get_catalog_page`

Load the next page of the catalog that is currently open (after open_catalog) and return its items.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `next_page` | boolean |  | Load the next page first (default false) |

Calls: `CatalogRepository.loadMore`

### `discover`

Browse the Discover section (Search tab with an empty query): pick a content type, a catalog and a genre, and return matching titles. Call with no arguments to see the available options.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string |  | Content type, e.g. movie or series |
| `catalog` | string |  | Catalog key or name from the options |
| `genre` | string |  | Genre from the options |
| `more` | boolean |  | Load the next page |

Calls: `SearchRepository.refreshDiscover`, `SearchRepository.selectDiscoverType`, `SearchRepository.selectDiscoverCatalog`, `SearchRepository.selectDiscoverGenre`, `SearchRepository.loadMoreDiscover`, `SearchRepository.discoverUiState`

### `get_search_history` — parallel

Return the recent search queries.

Calls: `SearchHistoryRepository.uiState`, `SearchHistoryRepository.enabled`

### `remove_search_history_entry`

Remove one query from the recent searches list.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | The exact recent query to remove |

Calls: `SearchHistoryRepository.removeSearch`

## Titles, episodes and people

### `get_title_details` — parallel

Get full metadata for a movie or series: year, plot, genres, director, writers, cast (with tmdb_person_id), ratings, seasons, similar titles. Does not change the screen.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Title id, e.g. tt0133093 |
| `type` | string | yes | movie or series |

Calls: `MetaDetailsRepository.fetch`, `MetaDetailsRepository.peek`

### `list_episodes` — parallel

List the episodes of a series (optionally one season) with their video ids and air dates.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Series id |
| `season` | integer |  | Season number (omit for all) |

## Streams and starting playback

### `play_title`

Start watching a movie or a series episode: opens the stream list for it (the app's normal Play flow) and waits for streams to load. Then call play_stream(index) to start one. For series pass season and episode (default: S1E1, or the resume point if in progress).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Title id, e.g. tt0133093 |
| `type` | string | yes | movie or series |
| `season` | integer |  | Season number (series) |
| `episode` | integer |  | Episode number (series) |
| `start_over` | boolean |  | Start from the beginning instead of resuming |

Calls: `AgentNavigationHandle.openStreams`, `StreamsRepository.load`

### `list_streams` — parallel

List the streams on the open stream screen (index, quality/name, addon, kind). Waits briefly for addons still loading.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addon` | string |  | Only streams from this addon name |

Calls: `StreamsRepository.uiState`

### `filter_streams_by_addon`

Filter the stream list on screen to a single addon (or clear the filter).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addon` | string |  | Addon name or id; omit to show all |

Calls: `StreamsRepository.selectFilter`

### `play_stream`

Start playing stream number `index` from list_streams (opens the player). Waits until the player is up.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | integer | yes | Stream index from list_streams |

Calls: `AgentStreamScreenHandle.playStream`

## Player controls

### `get_player_state` — parallel

What is playing: title/episode, position and duration (seconds), playing/paused, speed, audio tracks, built-in subtitle tracks and addon subtitles (with indices/ids), subtitle delay.

Calls: `AgentPlayerHandle.state`

### `player_pause`

Pause playback.

Calls: `AgentPlayerHandle.pause`

### `player_resume`

Resume (play) playback.

Calls: `AgentPlayerHandle.play`

### `player_seek`

Seek. Use position_seconds for an absolute position (e.g. 90 = 1:30) or offset_seconds to jump relative to now (e.g. -10 to rewind ten seconds).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position_seconds` | number |  | Absolute position in seconds |
| `offset_seconds` | number |  | Relative jump in seconds (negative rewinds) |

Calls: `AgentPlayerHandle.seekTo`, `AgentPlayerHandle.seekBy`

### `player_set_speed`

Set the playback speed (0.25–4.0, 1.0 = normal).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | number | yes | Playback speed multiplier |

Calls: `AgentPlayerHandle.setSpeed`

### `player_select_audio`

Switch the audio track by index (from get_player_state) or by language (e.g. "en", "English", "ja").

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | integer |  | Audio track index |
| `language` | string |  | Language name or code |

Calls: `AgentPlayerHandle.selectAudioTrack`

### `player_select_subtitles`

Turn subtitles on/off or change them. Pass language (e.g. "English") to pick the best match from built-in tracks first, then addon subtitles (fetched automatically if needed); or pass track_index / addon_subtitle_id exactly; or off=true to disable.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `language` | string |  | Language name or ISO code |
| `track_index` | integer |  | Built-in subtitle track index |
| `addon_subtitle_id` | string |  | Addon subtitle id from get_player_state |
| `off` | boolean |  | Disable subtitles |

Calls: `AgentPlayerHandle.selectSubtitleTrack`, `AgentPlayerHandle.selectAddonSubtitle`, `AgentPlayerHandle.disableSubtitles`, `AgentPlayerHandle.fetchAddonSubtitles`

### `player_set_subtitle_delay`

Shift subtitle timing in milliseconds (positive = later, negative = earlier, 0 = reset).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delay_ms` | integer | yes | Delay in ms (-60000..60000) |

Calls: `AgentPlayerHandle.setSubtitleDelay`

### `player_next_episode`

Play the next episode of the series that is playing (uses the app's next-episode flow).

Calls: `AgentPlayerHandle.playNextEpisode`

### `player_close`

Close the player (progress is saved) and return to the previous screen.

Calls: `AgentPlayerHandle.close`

## Library and lists

### `get_library` — parallel

List the titles saved in the user's library (optionally only movies or series).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `movie` \| `series` \| `any` |  | Filter by type |
| `limit` | integer |  | Max items (default 50) |

Calls: `LibraryRepository.uiState`, `LibraryRepository.savedItem`

### `is_in_library` — parallel

Check whether a title is saved in the library.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Title id |
| `type` | string |  | movie or series |

Calls: `LibraryRepository.isSaved`

### `add_to_library`

Save a title to the library (no-op if already saved). Use the id/type of the title, e.g. the one on screen.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Title id |
| `type` | string | yes | movie or series |

Calls: `LibraryRepository.toggleSaved`, `LibraryRepository.save`, `LibraryRepository.toggleLocalSaved`

### `remove_from_library` — ⚠ confirm

Remove a title from the library. Asks the user to confirm.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Title id |
| `type` | string | yes | movie or series |

Calls: `LibraryRepository.remove`, `LibraryRepository.removeFromList`

### `clear_library` — ⚠ confirm

Remove EVERY title from the library. Destructive: the user must confirm.

Calls: `LibraryRepository.clearLocalState`

## Watch progress and watched state

### `get_continue_watching` — parallel

List the Continue Watching items (in-progress movies/episodes) with progress and resume points.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer |  | Max items (default 20) |

Calls: `WatchProgressRepository.continueWatching`, `WatchProgressRepository.uiState`

### `get_watch_progress` — parallel

Get saved progress for a movie or an episode (by video id, or series id + season/episode).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Movie id, series id or episode video id |
| `season` | integer |  | Season (series) |
| `episode` | integer |  | Episode (series) |

Calls: `WatchProgressRepository.progressForVideo`, `WatchProgressRepository.resumeEntryForSeries`

### `remove_from_continue_watching` — ⚠ confirm

Remove a title (and its saved progress) from Continue Watching.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Movie or series id |
| `season` | integer |  | Only this season (series) |
| `episode` | integer |  | Only this episode (series) |

Calls: `WatchProgressRepository.removeProgress`, `WatchProgressRepository.clearProgress`

### `set_watched`

Mark a movie or an episode as watched (watched=true) or unwatched (watched=false).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Movie or series id |
| `type` | string | yes | movie or series |
| `season` | integer |  | Season (for an episode) |
| `episode` | integer |  | Episode (for an episode) |
| `watched` | boolean |  | true = watched, false = unwatched (default true) |

Calls: `WatchedRepository.markWatched`, `WatchedRepository.unmarkWatched`, `WatchedRepository.toggleWatched`

### `is_watched` — parallel

Check whether a movie, an episode, or a whole series is marked watched.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Movie or series id |
| `type` | string | yes | movie or series |
| `season` | integer |  | Season |
| `episode` | integer |  | Episode |

Calls: `WatchedRepository.isWatched`, `WatchedRepository.isFullyWatchedSeries`, `WatchedRepository.uiState`

## Addon management

### `list_addons` — parallel

List installed Stremio addons in order: name, id, manifest URL, enabled, resources, types and catalogs.

Calls: `AddonRepository.uiState`

### `install_addon`

Install a Stremio addon from its manifest URL (https://…/manifest.json or stremio://…). Well-known: Cinemeta https://v3-cinemeta.strem.io/manifest.json (metadata/catalogs), OpenSubtitles v3 https://opensubtitles-v3.strem.io/manifest.json (subtitles).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes | Manifest URL |

Calls: `AddonRepository.addAddon`, `AddonRepository.awaitManifestsLoaded`

### `remove_addon` — ⚠ confirm

Uninstall an addon (by name, id or manifest URL). Asks the user to confirm.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addon` | string | yes | Addon name, id or manifest URL |

Calls: `AddonRepository.removeAddon`

### `set_addon_enabled`

Enable or disable an installed addon without uninstalling it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addon` | string | yes | Addon name, id or manifest URL |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes | true to enable, false to disable |

Calls: `AddonRepository.setAddonEnabled`

### `move_addon`

Reorder addons: move an addon to a new position (0 = first). Order affects stream and catalog priority.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addon` | string | yes | Addon name, id or manifest URL |
| `to_index` | integer | yes | New position (0-based) |

Calls: `AddonRepository.moveAddon`

### `refresh_addons`

Re-download addon manifests (all, or one addon) to pick up updates or fix load errors.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addon` | string |  | Only this addon (name, id or URL) |

Calls: `AddonRepository.refreshAll`, `AddonRepository.refreshAddon`

## Settings

### `list_settings` — parallel

List the app settings the assistant can change, with their current values, types and allowed options.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `section` | `playback` \| `streams` \| `appearance` \| `details_screen` \| `continue_watching` \| `home` \| `search` |  | Only this section |

### `set_setting`

Change one setting by key (from list_settings). Values: true/false, numbers, or one of the listed options.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | Setting key, e.g. player.subtitle_language |
| `value` | string | yes | New value |

### `list_home_rows_settings` — parallel

List Home screen catalog rows with their enabled state, custom titles and order.

Calls: `HomeCatalogSettingsRepository.uiState`

### `configure_home_row`

Show/hide a Home row, rename it, include it in the hero carousel, or move it up/down.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | Row key from list_home_rows_settings |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Show (true) or hide (false) the row |
| `title` | string |  | Custom title (empty resets) |
| `hero_source` | boolean |  | Use this row in the hero carousel |
| `move` | `up` \| `down` |  | Move the row |

Calls: `HomeCatalogSettingsRepository.setEnabled`, `HomeCatalogSettingsRepository.setCustomTitle`, `HomeCatalogSettingsRepository.setHeroSourceEnabled`, `HomeCatalogSettingsRepository.moveUp`, `HomeCatalogSettingsRepository.moveDown`, `HomeCatalogSettingsRepository.moveByIndex`

### `reset_home_rows` — ⚠ confirm

Reset Home rows (order, visibility, titles) to defaults. Asks the user to confirm.

Calls: `HomeCatalogSettingsRepository.resetToDefaults`

### `reset_details_layout` — ⚠ confirm

Reset the title-page section layout to defaults. Asks the user to confirm.

Calls: `MetaScreenSettingsRepository.resetToDefaults`

## Account and profiles

### `get_account` — parallel

Account and profile info: signed-in state (guest or email), profiles and which one is active.

Calls: `AuthRepository.state`, `ProfileRepository.state`, `ProfileRepository.activeProfileId`

### `switch_profile` — ⚠ confirm

Switch to another profile (changes library, progress and addons shown). Asks the user to confirm. PIN-protected profiles must be opened by the user.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profile_index` | integer | yes | Profile index from get_account |

Calls: `ProfileRepository.selectProfile`

### `sign_out` — ⚠ confirm

Sign out of the Nuvio account on this device. Asks the user to confirm.

Calls: `AuthRepository.signOut`

## Downloads

### `list_downloads` — parallel

List downloads with status (downloading, paused, completed, failed) and progress.

Calls: `DownloadsRepository.uiState`

### `download_stream`

Download stream `index` from the open stream list for offline viewing (direct HTTP streams only).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | integer | yes | Stream index from list_streams |

Calls: `DownloadsRepository.enqueueFromStream`, `AgentStreamScreenHandle.request`

### `manage_download` — ⚠ confirm

Pause, resume, retry or cancel a download (cancel deletes the partial file and asks to confirm).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `pause` \| `resume` \| `retry` \| `cancel` \| `pause_all` | yes | What to do |
| `download_id` | string |  | Download id from list_downloads (not needed for pause_all) |

Calls: `DownloadsRepository.pauseDownload`, `DownloadsRepository.resumeDownload`, `DownloadsRepository.retryDownload`, `DownloadsRepository.cancelDownload`, `DownloadsRepository.pauseActiveDownloads`

## Collections

### `list_collections` — parallel

List the user's collections (custom groups of catalogs) and their folders.

Calls: `CollectionRepository.collections`, `CollectionRepository.getCollection`

### `delete_collection` — ⚠ confirm

Delete a collection. Asks the user to confirm.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collection_id` | string | yes | Collection id from list_collections |

Calls: `CollectionRepository.removeCollection`

### `move_collection`

Move a collection up or down in the list.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collection_id` | string | yes | Collection id |
| `direction` | `up` \| `down` | yes | up or down |

Calls: `CollectionRepository.moveUp`, `CollectionRepository.moveDown`, `CollectionRepository.moveByIndex`

## Web search and fetch

### `web_search` — parallel

Search the web (DuckDuckGo by default; Brave, Tavily or SearXNG if configured in Agent settings). Use for facts the app doesn't know: directors, cast trivia, release dates, "what should I watch" lists. Returns titles, URLs and snippets; use fetch_url to read a page.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Search query |
| `max_results` | integer |  | Results to return (default 6) |
| `backend` | `duckduckgo` \| `searxngpublic` \| `brave` \| `tavily` \| `searxng` |  | Force a backend |

### `fetch_url` — parallel

Download a web page and return its readable text (scripts/menus stripped). Max 2 MB download, 20 s timeout; returns up to max_chars characters starting at offset (page through long pages).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes | http(s) URL |
| `max_chars` | integer |  | Characters to return (default 6000) |
| `offset` | integer |  | Start offset into the extracted text |

## Stremio addon protocol (direct)

### `addon_manifest` — parallel

Fetch an addon's manifest (any URL, or an installed addon by name) — useful before installing to see what it provides.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addon` | string | yes | Manifest URL or installed addon name/id |

### `addon_catalog` — parallel

Query an addon's /catalog resource directly (with optional search, genre or skip extras).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addon` | string | yes | Manifest URL or installed addon name/id |
| `type` | string | yes | Content type, e.g. movie |
| `catalog_id` | string | yes | Catalog id, e.g. top |
| `search` | string |  | Search query extra |
| `genre` | string |  | Genre extra |
| `skip` | integer |  | Pagination offset |
| `limit` | integer |  | Items to return (default 20) |

### `addon_meta` — parallel

Query an addon's /meta resource directly for one title (raw addon metadata).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addon` | string | yes | Manifest URL or installed addon name/id |
| `type` | string | yes | movie or series |
| `id` | string | yes | Title id |

### `addon_streams` — parallel

Query /stream directly: which streams an addon offers for a title or episode id (series: tt…:season:episode).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addon` | string | yes | Manifest URL or installed addon name/id |
| `type` | string | yes | movie or series |
| `id` | string | yes | Video id, e.g. tt0133093 or tt0903747:1:1 |

### `addon_subtitles` — parallel

Query /subtitles directly: subtitle tracks an addon (e.g. OpenSubtitles) has for a title or episode.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addon` | string | yes | Manifest URL or installed addon name/id |
| `type` | string | yes | movie or series |
| `id` | string | yes | Video id |
| `language` | string |  | Only this language (ISO 639-2, e.g. eng) |

## Utilities

### `calculate` — parallel

Evaluate an arithmetic expression exactly (+ - * / % ^, parentheses, sqrt, abs, round, floor, ceil, min, max). E.g. runtime math.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expression` | string | yes | Expression, e.g. (2*60+16)/60 |

### `get_current_time` — parallel

Current date/time (optionally in another IANA time zone), plus days until/since a date if given.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time_zone` | string |  | IANA zone, e.g. Europe/Paris (default: device zone) |
| `compare_date` | string |  | ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to compute days until/since |

## Agent memory

### `remember`

Save a lasting user preference or fact (e.g. key=subtitle_language value=English). Remembered items are shown to you in every conversation.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | Short key, e.g. favorite_genre |
| `value` | string | yes | What to remember |

### `recall` — parallel

List everything remembered about the user.

### `forget` — ⚠ confirm

Forget one remembered item (by key), or everything with key="*" (asks to confirm).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | Key to forget, or * for all |

- **Custom colour editor needs a visual picker; the assistant can switch between themes via set_setting.** `ThemeSettingsRepository.setCustomTheme`
- **Pure presentation state of a screen (overlay visibility, scroll, animations).** `MetaScreenSettingsRepository.moveByIndex`, `MetaScreenSettingsRepository.setTabGroup`
- **Section toggles for the title page are drag-and-drop layout edits done in the layout editor.** `MetaScreenSettingsRepository.setEnabled`
- **Rarely used three-way layout option; available in the details settings screen (open_settings).** `MetaScreenSettingsRepository.setEpisodeRatingsVisibility`
- **Collections are built in the visual collection editor (folders, artwork, catalog sources).** `CollectionRepository.addCollection`, `CollectionRepository.updateCollection`
- **Export/import of collection JSON is a file-sharing flow handled by the UI.** `CollectionRepository.exportToJson`, `CollectionRepository.importFromJson`
- **Subtitle font/colour/outline styling needs the visual style panel.** `PlayerSettingsRepository.setSubtitleStyle`
- **Low-level decoder output; misconfiguration can break playback, left to the advanced UI.** `PlayerSettingsRepository.setAndroidLibmpvVideoOutput`
- **Multi-select list edited in the playback settings UI.** `PlayerSettingsRepository.setStreamAutoPlaySelectedAddons`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setStreamAutoPlaySelectedPlugins`
- **Per-segment auto-skip matrix edited in the playback settings UI.** `PlayerSettingsRepository.setAutoSkipSegmentTypeEnabled`
- **Requires credentials or a PIN the assistant must never handle; the user does this in the UI.** `AuthRepository.signInWithEmail`, `AuthRepository.signUpWithEmail`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setAnimeSkipClientId`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIntroDbApiKey`, `ProfileRepository.clearPin`, `ProfileRepository.clearPinWithPassword`, `ProfileRepository.setPin`, `ProfileRepository.verifyPin`
- **Exposed through get_search_history.** `SearchHistoryRepository.uiState`
- **Onboarding choice made by the user before the app (and the assistant) is reachable.** `AuthRepository.signInAnonymously`
- **Irreversible account deletion is never delegated to the assistant.** `AuthRepository.deleteAccount`
- **Profile creation needs avatar/name choices in the profile editor.** `ProfileRepository.createProfile`
- **Profile editing needs avatar/name choices in the profile editor.** `ProfileRepository.updateProfile`
- **Deleting a profile and its data is left to the profile editor.** `ProfileRepository.deleteProfile`
- **Profile-picker preference shown only on the profile picker.** `ProfileRepository.setRememberLastProfileEnabled`
- **iOS-only player option (this is the Android app).** `PlayerSettingsRepository.resetIosVideoOutputTuning`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosAudioOutputMode`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosBrightness`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosContrast`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosDebandEnabled`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosExtendedDynamicRangeEnabled`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosGamma`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosHardwareDecoderMode`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosHdrComputePeakEnabled`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosInterpolationEnabled`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosSaturation`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosTargetColorspaceHintEnabled`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosTargetPrimaries`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosTargetTransfer`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosToneMappingMode`, `PlayerSettingsRepository.setIosVideoOutputPreset`
